message: a value allocated in region `r` is stored into parameter `c` of `evil`, which lives in this function's own region (its caller's current region) - `evil` stores its parameter `x` into it
help: MM-RGN-3 (docs/memory-model-v2-design.md): a value may be stored only into a place its own region OUTLIVES, because the place is still readable after the value's region has been reclaimed. A region named in a signature (`@r`) outlives the function's own region and is unordered against another name; the function's own region is its caller's. Keep the value in the region of the place it is stored into - allocate it there, or copy it there - or widen the place's annotation to the value's region
